name: Feature showcase
steps: Open a compatible section or parent block in the theme editor, select Add block, and choose Feature showcase. The parent controls its available space and overall layout.
Configure the block’s content first, then its presentation. Drag the block in its parent to change its position.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Eyebrow
settings.how: Enter the eyebrow. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Text
settings.how: Use the rich text editor for paragraphs, lists, emphasis, and links. Use descriptive link text and headings in a logical order.

settings.label: Button link
settings.how: Select a Shopify destination or paste a valid URL. Use a descriptive button or link label. Empty destinations usually hide the associated action.

settings.label: Media type
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for media type. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Image or video poster
settings.how: Select or upload an image. Add descriptive alt text and set its focal point in Shopify Files. Check the crop on both desktop and mobile; the image does not change the original file.

settings.label: Uploaded video
settings.how: Select a video uploaded to Shopify Files. Supply a clear poster image where offered. Leave autoplay off for content that needs sound.

settings.label: External video link

settings.label: Autoplay uploaded video
settings.how: Turn on “Autoplay uploaded video” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.
